name: astro
notes: Server output with the standalone Node adapter - self-hosted, like borgo. Every route sets `prerender = false`, because Astro's default would turn /page into a build-time static file and the scenario is per-request rendering. The React counter is an island (client:load), which is Astro's idiom; Astro therefore ships less client JS than the React frameworks here by design, not by accident. The shared dataset module is copied into src/lib at build time.
